votes.bill_title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027
votes.plain_language: The House voted to accept the Senate's rewrite of this bill, which became a stopgap that funds federal agencies into fiscal year 2027, generally through December 11, 2026, and extends several expiring programs. I had a productive visit with Central Iowa Water Works and West Des Moines Water Works at the A.C. Ward Municipal Treatment Plant. They showed me all the work they have done to streamline the water treatment process and deliver safe drinking water to the residents in West Des Moines. 

I’m proud to have secured $20 million in federal funding to upgrade drinking water and wastewater infrastructure in my district, and I’ll always work with anyone to bring as much funding as possible back to Iowa to ensure families have access to safe, reliable water.
